text: Ethics in AI is becoming a major topic today. One important issue is bias, because AI systems can learn from data that is not fair. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups. Fairness means AI should treat everyone equally. Privacy is also a concern, since AI often collects and uses personal data. People need to know how their information is used and protected. Transparency is important too, so users can understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that keep AI safe, fair, and helpful for everyone.
